searchParameters.q: (nitrile rubber OR NBR) AND (polymerization OR emulsion) AND acrylonitrile

patents.title: Process for producing low acrylonitrile content nitrile rubber by emulsion polymerization
patents.snippet: An aqueous emulsion polymerization process for preparing nitrile butadiene rubber (NBR) having acrylonitrile content of 15-20 wt% using a redox initiator system and anionic emulsifier.

patents.title: Emulsion polymerization of acrylonitrile-butadiene copolymers with controlled ACN content
patents.snippet: Method for preparing NBR latex in aqueous phase with acrylonitrile feed ratio adjusted to obtain bound acrylonitrile of about 18 wt%. Uses potassium persulfate and sodium lauryl sulfate emulsifier.

patents.title: Solution polymerization of nitrile rubber using n-butyllithium in hexane
patents.snippet: Anionic solution polymerization of acrylonitrile and butadiene in hexane solvent initiated with n-butyllithium and THF polar modifier to produce living NBR chains.

patents.title: Process for producing hydrogenated nitrile rubber (HNBR) with high saturation
patents.snippet: Selective hydrogenation of NBR latex to produce highly saturated nitrile rubber (HNBR) using a Wilkinson-type catalyst under hydrogen pressure.

patents.title: Pneumatic tire comprising nitrile rubber composition in sidewall
patents.snippet: A pneumatic tire having a sidewall rubber composition containing purchased NBR as a compounding ingredient together with carbon black and sulfur vulcanizing agents.

patents.title: Adhesive composition containing acrylonitrile-butadiene rubber for metal bonding
patents.snippet: A structural adhesive formulation comprising commercially available NBR dissolved in solvent with phenolic resin for bonding metal substrates.

patents.title: Method for purifying drinking water using activated carbon filters
patents.snippet: A water treatment system employing granular activated carbon and ion-exchange resins; unrelated to polymer synthesis.

patents.title: Aqueous emulsion copolymerization of styrene-butadiene with low styrene content
patents.snippet: Preparation of SBR latex by cold emulsion polymerization with styrene content 15-25 wt%, using redox initiation and fatty acid soap emulsifier.

patents.title: Wellbore packer seal comprising hydrogenated nitrile elastomer
patents.snippet: An oilfield packer element molded from HNBR elastomer compound for high-temperature wellbore sealing applications.

patents.title: Continuous emulsion polymerization process for acrylonitrile-butadiene rubber
patents.snippet: Multi-reactor continuous aqueous emulsion polymerization of acrylonitrile and butadiene with surfactant and chain transfer agent to control molecular weight and ACN bound content.
